title: C2MS-SP 잔차 블록 가운데 채널 축소 구조의 20에폭 미세조정 단일 시드 확인
hypothesis: The 85 reduced structures (B32W96 68% MACs, B32W64 51%), made from the 65 weights by channel selection + least-squares refit and fine-tuned for 20 epochs with the 65 loss, reach the same-seed C2MS-SP on RR (seed 42) with fewer parameters and MACs; with the 86 projection and inference settings their time is reported at 256^2 and 512^2.

evidence.85_stage0: 85 reduced structures were not trained: 256^2 network time 94-98% of C2MS (speed gate 0.95), 512^2 73-93%; reduction init residual error median 1.0-2.6%
evidence.83_K2: 83 K2 (66% MACs, CP-depthwise) recovered most of the factorization loss within 1 epoch; 90% of the 40-epoch validation gain by epoch 13-14 (K2L)
evidence.single_seed: user decision 2026-11-18: test the reduction + short fine-tuning with seed 42 before any 3-seed run

reduction: per block in forward order: kept channels = top contribution energy E[h_c^2]*||W_b[:,c]||^2 over 512 training patches (fixed generator, seed 0); first 3x3 keeps its rows; second 3x3 weights and bias refit by ridge least squares (1e-6 x mean diagonal) to the original block residual output, with the inputs of the already-reduced model
loss: 65 loss: original per-pixel L1 + 1.0 x per-pixel L1 on 2x coarser pairs + 0.46 x spectral loss on the original pair (history fields train_mse/coarse_train_mse hold mean absolute errors)
ema_note: EMA recorded only (as 65); selection uses the online weights
schedule: Adam lr = 1e-6 + 0.5 * (5e-5 - 1e-6) * (1 + cos(pi * zero_based_epoch / (E - 1))), E = 20; epoch 0 validation is the reduced model before any update
projection_note: K10 with the test sensor operator; prepare.FastProjected (86 FastProjectedV2) if the 86 identity check passed (identity_record), else 83 Projected

transfer_tests.WV2: WV3-trained runs are also evaluated on WV2 with the 82 per-band calibration (reference only under v2.4)

comparisons.official: arm + projection vs the same-seed C2MS-SP (65 + the same projection), per training sensor, seed 42, v2.4 (RR only, single-seed threshold 0.06 dB); an arm is an improvement only if QB, GF2 and WV3 all are
comparisons.reference: arm + projection vs C2MS-SP within -0.04 dB on every sensor is reported as light non-inferior (not a judgement); 83 K2/K2L and 85 FT0L seed-42 records for context
comparisons.cost: used parameters, 256^2 MACs, GPU time at 256^2 and 512^2 (official setting and the 86 inference settings)

stages.0: reduced initial weights (seed 42), projection choice from 86
stages.1: both arms on QB, GF2, WV3, seed 42, 20 epochs, two trainings at once, evaluation

expected_duration: about 3-4 h of training (6 runs of 20 epochs, two at once) plus about 1 h for preparation, evaluation and timing (estimate)
limits: single seed: a positive result needs a 3-seed run before any baseline decision
QB: 84 and 85 showed little QB gain from extra training
precision: FP16 AMP training with GradScaler; FP32 loss, validation and evaluation; channel reduction in float32 with float64 accumulation on the GPU
scenes_note: fixed QB scene indices reused on GF2, WV3 and WV2 (as 65/80); images for seed 42 only
selection: minimum original-scale validation MSE including epoch 0 (the reduced model before fine-tuning; for FT0L the 65 weights), earliest exact tie; test never used for selection

latency.setting: one process, no training on the GPU, batch 1, test scene 0 (RR 256^2, FR 512^2), float32, TF32 off, cuDNN deterministic, autotune off, NCHW; 5 warm-up, 50 timed runs per system interleaved, 3 rounds, median of the round medians
latency.reference: cuDNN autotune + TF32 and FP16 autocast timings and the FP16 RR change (never a judgement)
